description:
This release needs fresh installation
Payload dumper extracts boot.img and other partition images (boot, vendor_boot, etc.) from a payload.bin or ota.zip directly on your Android device.
- real-time extraction progress - hash verification for extracted images - extract directly from OTA zip files - Debug logging - enhanced troubleshooting and debugging - Incremental detection - identifies incremental OTAs (extraction not supported yet!) - Parallel extraction - allow selecting additional images while extraction is in progress - Cancel extraction - option to abort an ongoing extraction process Upcoming features: - option to select from/to USB storage
